newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Mining equipment maker to join Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Mining equipment maker to join Bucharest bourse.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Monday that state-run mining equipment maker Grimex SA would join the bourse on April 2, bringing to 27 the number of the listings in both tiers.
The company, based in southwestern town of Tirgu Jiu, close to the country's main coalmining region, will join 24 stocks on the exchange's second-tier.
Grimex SA has a capital of 24.68 billion lei in 994,465 shares with a face value of 25,000 lei each.
The company was included in a 1995 mass selloff scheme offering Romanians stakes of up to 60 percent in 4,000 companies in exchange for coupons.

Subscription was slighty over 45 percent for Grimex SA. The company's majority stockholder is the State Ownership Fund (FPS) with a 51.2 percent stake. Private stockholders hold 45.4 percent, with 3.4 percent held by employees.
Bourse activity, thin in 1996, recovered this year, with more listings and volumes on the rise since early January.
